children: -- The Board of Directors of National Fuel Gas Company

today approved a regular quarterly dividend of 55.5 cents per share on the Company's common stock. The dividend is payable October 15, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. The Company has approximately 95.0 million shares of common stock outstanding. It has no preferred stock outstanding.

National Fuel is a diversified energy company headquartered in Western New York that operates an integrated collection of natural gas assets across three operating segments: Integrated Upstream and Gathering, Pipeline and Storage, and Utility.
